hero.text: The depot, Pilotix and each delivery company are compared every 30 minutes, parcel by parcel and dinar by dinar. Each company alone, with its own delays.

co.noApi: No API: depot and cash only

empty.open: Nothing to fix here: everything matches.
empty.closed: Nothing fixed in the last 7 days.

did.alert: Pilotix put it in Follow-up › Alerts

act.receivedDone: Return received: written in its history

no_tracking.do: Send it to {{co}} again from Depot › In dispatch.

out_not_taken.t: Left the depot, {{co}} never took it
out_not_taken.do: Look for the parcel (at the depot, with {{co}}’s driver) and ask {{co}}.

taken_not_scanned.t: {{co}} took it without the depot’s scan
taken_not_scanned.do: Check it really left, then « Seen ». Always scan a parcel before handing it over.

cancelled_but_out.t: Cancelled, but the parcel did not come back
cancelled_but_out.do: Ask {{co}} for the return, then scan it in Depot › Returns.

stop_words.t: {{co}} says « {{words}} », Pilotix said « Out for delivery »
stop_words.do: Call the customer: the parcel will not be delivered as it is.

unknown_words.do: Tell Pilotix what these words mean (Delivery › Companies › Statuses).

delivered_not_in_pilotix.t: {{co}} says delivered, Pilotix did not follow
delivered_not_in_pilotix.do: Open the order and check its status.

delivered_but_returning.do: Check with {{co}}: delivered or coming back? Its money did not come.

lost_at_company.do: Make a claim to {{co}} to be paid back.

sync_down.t: {{co}} does not answer Pilotix any more
sync_down.do: Its parcels no longer move in Pilotix. Check its API key (Delivery › API).

return_not_scanned.t: {{co}} says it gave it back, the depot never scanned it
return_not_scanned.do: Find it at the depot and scan it (Depot › Returns), or claim it from {{co}}.
return_not_scanned.stock: Pilotix already put it back in stock.

return_but_delivered.t: Return scanned at the depot, but {{co}} says delivered
return_but_delivered.do: Was the right parcel scanned? Ask {{co}}.

not_paid.livreur: Delivered by our driver, money not handed in
not_paid.do: Ask {{co}} for the payment, or receive it in Cash.
not_paid.doLivreur: Collect the money from the driver (Cash › Drivers).

payout_waiting.t: Payment {{ref}} ready at {{co}}, not picked up
payout_waiting.do: Pick it up, then « Received » in Cash.

payout_not_in_caisse.t: Payment {{ref}} handed over by {{co}}, not in a cash box
payout_not_in_caisse.removed: {{co}}’s payment {{ref}} taken out of the cash box
payout_not_in_caisse.do: Put it in a cash box (Cash › Payments).

paid_unknown.do: Ask {{co}}: a parcel made outside Pilotix, or another shop’s?

paid_twice.do: {{co}} will take it back: keep this money aside.

paid_but_back.t: Paid by {{co}}, but the parcel is at the depot
paid_but_back.do: Tell {{co}} before it takes it back.
